messages.subject: DIF in mirt
parts:
Hi Phil and fellow mirt() users, 

I am running DIF on a 16-item, 3-factor measure, yet I keep running into issues in which the M-step optimizer did not converge. 

The code is as follows: 

# METRIC MODEL
mod3_metric <- multipleGroup(measure, models3, group=group,
                             invariance=c('slopes','free_means','free_varcov'))
mod3_metric.values <- mod2values(mod3_metric)

# RUN DIF
estmodels3 <- vector('list', ncol(measure))

for (i in 1:ncol(measure))
  estmodels3[[i]] <- multipleGroup(measure, models3, group=group, method='MHRM', verbose=FALSE,
                                   invariance=c('slopes','free_means','free_varcov',itemnames[-i]),
                                   technical=list(NCYCLES=5000))

However, the metric model does not converge, with the following error: 

Iteration: 11, Log-Lik: -11806.076, Max-Change: 0.05609Iteration: 14, Log-Lik: -11838.437, Max-Change: 0.25458
Error in Mstep(pars = pars, est = est, longpars = longpars, ngroups = ngroups,  : 
  Error in fn(par, ...) : M-step optimizer did not converge. 
                         Item 1 in group 2 had the following extreme parameters:
  a1 = 24  a2 = 04  a3 = 04  d1 = 04  d2 = -34
In addition: Warning message:
In log(eigen(sigma, symmetric = TRUE, only.values = TRUE)$values) 
    NANs produced

The model did converge if slopes were fixed (i.e., in a reference model), and the estimated parameters were not extreme for Item 1.

Does anyone have any suggestions as to how to fix this issue? 

Thanks,
Siny.
